data.body: PR #33 at 9f12f3e. Plan review signed PASS 0 blocking. Three plan advisories investigated; two were the reviewer comparing the premise against the already-fixed tree, the third was a genuine count error in the description and an over-broad exemption list, now pruned from ten entries to the five files that actually carry the marker. Code review PASS 0 blocking 0 advisory after strengthening the operator-config invariant to assert the example stays tracked. Local inv ci 1521 passed 6 skipped eval-gate PASS. GitHub CI pass in 1m58s. All seven acceptance criterion selectors proven individually and each invariant falsified by reintroducing the leak it guards.
